name: cited_oracle_inputs: weather entry (positive ALLOW)
notes: raw_value keys are in JCS order (observed_at before temp_f).
value_hash = sha256(JCS(raw_value)) where JCS sorts keys lexicographically.
feed_claimed_at is optional; present here from HTTP Last-Modified mirror.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: OFAC entry (positive DENY; SDN match)
notes: source_url uses vault:// scheme for offline snapshot per spec Section 1.1 table.
source_cursor carries the OFAC list_version (informational; NOT the pattern-13 cache-cursor primitive).
raw_value.match is an array of SDN entry hashes, not the full SDN entries themselves.
feed_claimed_at is omitted; null is forbidden per spec Section 1.3 rule 3.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: time entry (system clock)
notes: source_url uses system: scheme for non-HTTP sources per spec Section 1.1.
fetched_at equals now_utc because the gate stamps at the moment of clock read.
No optional fields present; both feed_claimed_at and source_cursor are absent (not null).

name: cited_oracle_inputs: sms_hitl entry (inbound YES reply)
notes: to field is E.164. PII; must be stored under tenant scope per spec Section 1.8.
direction: in means this is the inbound HITL reply, not the outbound prompt.
provider_message_sid is non-PII and safe for aggregate counts.

name: cited_oracle_inputs: webhook entry (in-browser eval fallback)
notes: Webhook response body is NOT stored in raw_value; only response_body_hash is cited.
status_code_or_eval_result carries the eval result JSON for in_browser_eval kind.
source_url is a WebSocket endpoint identifier, not an HTTP URL.
